items.question: 每个月的平均订单金额（按订单明细商品金额计）是多少？
items.goldSql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
items.actualSql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 最近 30 天内有登录记录的会员有多少人？
items.goldSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM members
WHERE last_login_date > (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members) - 30;
items.actualSql:
-- 以会员表自身最大登录日期为基准，统计近30天内有登录的去重会员数
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
FROM members
WHERE last_login_date >= (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members) - INTERVAL '30 days';

items.question: 每个订单状态的商品销售总额是多少？
items.actualSql:
SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(oi.price), 0), 2) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_status
LIMIT 100;

items.question: 每个州的评价平均分是多少？取评价数最多的 10 个州。
items.goldSql:
SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
items.actualSql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10;

items.question: 每种支付方式的评价平均分是多少？
items.goldSql:
SELECT p.payment_type, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM order_payments p
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_score DESC;
items.actualSql:
-- 先对 order_payments 按 order_id+payment_type 去重，避免一单多笔支付放大评价记录，再关联评价求平均分
SELECT op.payment_type,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, payment_type FROM order_payments) op
JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = op.order_id
GROUP BY op.payment_type
ORDER BY avg_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

items.question: 每个大区的商品销售额是多少？
items.goldSql:
SELECT r.macro_region, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC;
items.actualSql:
SELECT r.macro_region, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = s.seller_state
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 100;

items.question: 每个活动带来的用券次数是多少？
items.goldSql:
SELECT c.campaign_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM coupon_usages cu
JOIN coupons cp ON cp.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = cp.campaign_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cnt DESC;
items.actualSql:
SELECT c.campaign_id, COUNT(cu.usage_id) AS usage_count
FROM campaigns c
LEFT JOIN coupons cp ON cp.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = cp.coupon_id
GROUP BY c.campaign_id
ORDER BY c.campaign_id
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 每个仓库的库存总量和平均库存量分别是多少？
items.actualSql:
SELECT warehouse_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity, ROUND(AVG(quantity)::numeric, 2) AS avg_quantity
FROM inventory
GROUP BY warehouse_id
ORDER BY warehouse_id
LIMIT 100;

items.question: 每个发货状态的发货单平均有几条物流轨迹记录？
items.goldSql:
SELECT s.status, ROUND(AVG(t.cnt), 2) AS avg_events
FROM shipments s
JOIN (SELECT shipment_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipment_tracking GROUP BY 1) t
  ON t.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
items.actualSql:
SELECT status,
       ROUND(AVG(rec_count)::numeric, 2) AS avg_tracking_records
FROM (
    SELECT s.shipment_id,
           s.status,
           COUNT(st.tracking_id) AS rec_count
    FROM shipments s
    LEFT JOIN shipment_tracking st ON st.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
    GROUP BY s.shipment_id, s.status
) x
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status
LIMIT 10;

items.question: 每个类目的平均商品重量是多少？取商品数最多的 10 个类目。
items.goldSql:
SELECT p.product_category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS product_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(p.product_weight_g), 2) AS avg_weight
FROM products p
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND p.product_weight_g IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY product_cnt DESC LIMIT 10;
items.actualSql:
SELECT p.product_category_name,
       ROUND(AVG(p.product_weight_g)::numeric, 2) AS avg_product_weight
FROM products p
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY COUNT(p.product_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

items.question: 物流延迟类工单按客户所在州和会员等级分布，列出前 20 组。
items.goldSql:
SELECT c.customer_state, ml.level_name, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS tickets
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = st.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = st.member_id
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
WHERE tc.category_name = '物流延迟'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY tickets DESC LIMIT 20;
items.actualSql:
SELECT c.customer_state, m.level_id, COUNT(DISTINCT st.ticket_id) AS ticket_count
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON tc.category_id = st.category_id
JOIN members m ON m.member_id = st.member_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
WHERE tc.category_name = '物流延迟'
GROUP BY c.customer_state, m.level_id
ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, c.customer_state, m.level_id
LIMIT 20;

items.question: 物流轨迹事件类型按客户所在州分布，列出前 20 组（按发货单去重）。
items.goldSql:
SELECT st.event_code, c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT s.shipment_id) AS shipments
FROM shipment_tracking st
JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id = st.shipment_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY shipments DESC LIMIT 20;
items.actualSql:
SELECT st.event_code, c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT st.shipment_id) AS shipment_count
FROM shipment_tracking st
JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id = st.shipment_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY st.event_code, c.customer_state
ORDER BY shipment_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

items.question: 2018 年每个月的 GMV 中，新客和老客各贡献多少？
items.goldSql:
WITH first_order AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month,
         c.customer_unique_id,
         SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT m.month,
       ROUND(SUM(m.gmv) FILTER (WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', f.first_ts)::date = m.month), 2) AS new_customer_gmv,
       ROUND(SUM(m.gmv) FILTER (WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', f.first_ts)::date <> m.month), 2) AS returning_gmv
FROM monthly m
JOIN first_order f ON f.customer_unique_id = m.customer_unique_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
items.actualSql:
-- 按会员是否带有 NEW_USER 标签划分新客/老客，汇总 2018 年各月含运费 GMV
SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN nc.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS new_customer_gmv,
       round(sum(CASE WHEN nc.customer_unique_id IS NULL THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS old_customer_gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.customer_unique_id
  FROM user_tags t
  JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.tag_id = t.tag_id
  JOIN members m ON m.member_id = utm.member_id
  WHERE t.tag_code = 'NEW_USER'
) nc ON nc.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 12;

cohortInputReview.metricsText:
METRIC gmv_with_freight  -- GMV（含运费）= 商品金额 + 运费
  表达式: SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value)
  过滤条件（默认附加）: o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    —— 例外：只有用户明确覆盖此过滤，或当前指标说明明确规定该场景例外时才省略。类目、年份等其他维度限定不能自动取消此过滤；与它共同限定事实集合。
  GMV 含不含运费是行业里长期有争议的口径。本项目采用**含运费**，
  理由：运费是客户实际支付的金额，属于成交额。
